definitions: The fruit of any of a genus (Citrus) of usually thorny shrubs or trees of the rue family native to warm regions and widely cultivated for their edible fruit with a leathery rind and juicy pulp.
Any of various fruits, such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruits, that have a thick skin and a juicy, segmented pulp.
examples: Citrus fruits are a good source of vitamin C.
She enjoys a variety of citrus fruits, especially grapefruits.
The recipe calls for the zest of several citrus fruits.
